question: Should I change my job in the next few months?
note: The flagship question. Clean answer leads with the dasha transition (design decision 2), names only planets, signs and houses that are in the context, and closes on agency.
answer:
This is a genuinely good moment to be asking, because your chart is at a real turning point rather than a mid-cycle lull. You are in the closing sub-period of an 18-year Rahu mahadasha - the long planetary chapter that has shaped your ambitions - with a Jupiter mahadasha, a chapter of growth and mentors, beginning next. Endings and re-orientation are structurally expected right now, so the urge to move is not random.

Two things support acting over the next few months. Jupiter is exalted in Cancer, passing through your 10th house of career and profession for about eight more months, and that house is reported as strong in your chart. Today's career reading also points to networking bringing new opportunities.

The counterweight is Saturn, transiting Pisces in a demanding position from your natal Moon and moving through your 6th house of daily work for roughly two more years. That favours a deliberate, well-structured move over an impulsive one - the Mars sub-period adds drive and initiative, but also friction if rushed.

So the climate supports a change, and the timing is unusually apt for one. Use the next few months to build the relationships and the plan; let the decision itself be yours, made with the structure Saturn is asking for.

question: How will my relationship be this month?
note: Same user, different life area and horizon - the swap partner for jq-01. Names the 7th house, its lord Mars, and the debilitated Moon, all of which are in the context.
answer:
There is real room to move here this month. Two things shape the mood. Your Moon sits in Scorpio, where it is debilitated, so emotional reactions can run deeper and faster than the situation warrants; noticing that in the moment is half the work. And Jupiter, exalted in Cancer, is in a supportive position from your Moon for the next eight months or so, which lends perspective and goodwill to the conversations you do have.

So this month favours honest, deliberate conversation over big decisions. Mars gives you the initiative to start them; Jupiter gives you the generosity to have them well. What you build from that is yours to choose.

question: Is saal meri sehat kaisi rahegi?
note: Hindi user, gentle tone, plain jargon, 130-word cap. The clean answer is Devanagari; answer_en is the same answer in English and is what the wrong_language mutation sends.
answer:
इस साल सेहत को लेकर घबराने की ज़रूरत नहीं है। आपकी कुंडली में पहला भाव - यानी शरीर और ऊर्जा का घर - मज़बूत है, और चंद्रमा वृषभ में उच्च का है, जो मन को स्थिर रखता है।

शनि इस समय मीन राशि में है, जो आपके चंद्रमा से सहायक स्थिति है - यह अनुशासन और टिकाऊ सुधार का समय है। साथ ही बृहस्पति के लंबे दौर में शनि का छोटा दौर चल रहा है, इसलिए नियमित दिनचर्या, नींद और हल्की कसरत का असर इस साल सबसे ज़्यादा दिखेगा।

छठा भाव, जो रोज़मर्रा की सेहत से जुड़ा है, औसत है - लापरवाही से छोटी-मोटी दिक्कतें आ सकती हैं, पर बड़ी चिंता के संकेत नहीं हैं। आज का संकेत भी यही है: हल्की चहलकदमी ऊर्जा बढ़ाएगी। अपना ख़याल रखिए।
answer_en:
There is no need to worry about your health this year, but it does ask for some regularity. The 1st house in your chart - the house of body and vitality - is strong, and your Moon is exalted in Taurus, which keeps the mind steady.

Saturn is in Pisces, a supportive position from your Moon, so this is a time of discipline and slow, durable improvement. You are also running a Saturn sub-period inside a long Jupiter period, so routine, sleep and light exercise will show their effect most this year.

The 6th house, tied to everyday health, is average - carelessness can bring small niggles, but nothing points to a major concern. Today's reading says the same: light movement will lift your energy. Look after yourself, gently.

Let what you have built over the last few years settle. Steady work pays off now more than new, large commitments.
